scripts.build: npm run build:common && npm run build -w @qlpk/auth-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/patient-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/staff-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/appointment-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/medical-record-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/billing-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/pharmacy-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/notification-service && npm run build -w @qlpk/api-gateway && npm run build -w @qlpk/frontend
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose stop auth-service patient-service staff-service appointment-service medical-record-service pharmacy-service billing-service notification-service api-gateway frontend && docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run free:ports && npm run dev:infra && npm run build:common && concurrently -n auth,patient,staff,appt,medical,billing,pharmacy,notify,gateway,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,green,red,gray,white,blue "npm run dev -w @qlpk/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/patient-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/staff-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/appointment-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/medical-record-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/billing-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/pharmacy-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @qlpk/frontend"
scripts.db:migrate:status: docker compose --profile migration run --rm -e MIGRATION_DRY_RUN=1 db-migrate
scripts.test: npm run build:common && node --import tsx --test packages/common/test/*.test.ts services/appointment-service/test/*.test.ts services/appointment-service/test/*.test.mjs services/medical-record-service/test/*.test.ts services/billing-service/test/*.test.ts
